items.title: Submit a valid proof of hunting liability insurance (Jagdhaftpflichtversicherung)
items.action: Obtain a current hunting liability insurance confirmation and send it to the Fachdienst Waffen und Jagd so the hunting license can be issued without a new application.
items.consequence: Without a valid insurance proof the hunting license (Jagdschein) cannot be issued.

data.title: Rejection of three-year hunting license application
data.summary: The Kreis Musterdithmarschen (Fachdienst Waffen und Jagd) rejected Tjark Beispielholm's application for a three-year hunting license (Jagdschein) because his hunting liability insurance proof, which expired on 30 June 2026, is no longer valid. The license will be issued without a new application once valid proof of insurance is submitted. An objection (Widerspruch) is possible within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The authority cannot issue your hunting license because your insurance proof expired. You don't need to file a new application — just send a current insurance confirmation and the license will be issued. You may also disagree with this decision: you have the right to file an objection (Widerspruch), and the app shows until when this is possible. If you miss that window and don't act, the rejection stands.
